headline: First Swiss Spot Bitcoin ETF Launches on SIX Swiss Exchange
summary: The first Swiss spot bitcoin ETF, The Bitcoin Fund ETF, has launched on the SIX Swiss Exchange, sponsored and managed by BIT Asset Management.
why: Exchange-traded funds providing direct spot exposure broaden institutional and retail access to digital assets within regulated market structures.

impacts.name: The Bitcoin Fund ETF
impacts.why: A new spot bitcoin ETF was launched on the exchange.
